name: CSV Field
description: Provides a file field that stores an uploaded CSV file and renders it as an interactive HTML table.
project_description: CSV Field provides a dedicated file field type (csv_file) whose default formatter renders the uploaded CSV as an HTML table. The table is built on the client from the CSV file: PapaParse downloads and parses the file and the DataTables library turns it into an interactive, paginated, searchable, responsive table. Per-item display options (page length, searching, responsive mode, download link, autolinking of URL columns, first-column-as-row-header, accessibility labels) are configured on the field widget and encoded into a data-settings attribute consumed by the JavaScript. Rendering client-side reduces the HTML sent over the network. External libraries (PapaParse, DataTables, DataTables Responsive, Autolinker) load from CDN.
